activities.activity_name: Shell REST API Invocation & Stream Commands
activities.activity_description: Implement REST support for stream commands and create a shell interface to invoke REST APIs to validate StreamController operations (U1, U7).
Adapt the redis counter module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) to enable building streaming pipes with simple counters (U2).
Setup CI infrastructure for the spring-cloud-data (s-c-d) repository to build the project continuously on every commit (U3).
Implement a mechanism to resolve and add module-dependent JARs to the Spring Boot loader to handle external libraries required by out-of-the-box modules (U4).
Migrate the ModuleLauncher to a Spring Boot application to leverage its support for properties, settings, and future functionality like CP augmentation (U5).
Investigate the right approach to port PHD as the provider to support the HDFS module from XD, focusing on handling HDFS dependencies loaded in the root classpath at runtime (U6).
Setup CI infrastructure for the spring-cloud-stream-modules (s-c-s-m) repository to build the project continuously on every commit (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of the new shell commands, bootified launcher, external JAR loading, and adapted modules to ensure system stability.
